From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro to unblock POC

Tom / Alice — thanks again for taking the time on the discovery call today. I wanted to follow up with a short recap and a proposed next step to keep momentum on the POC.

Recap (1 pager):
- Primary use case: high-throughput payments reconciliation (low-latency inference for rule matching)
- Success criteria: <10ms median token latency, integrated audit logs, deterministic cost estimate for 100k msgs/day
- Key blockers: exec alignment on architecture and data controls, confirmation of infra support window

Goal: schedule a 30–45 minute exec alignment call (VP Product + CTO) so we can:
- Walk our recommended POC architecture and required infra commitments
- Confirm SLAs and data handling roadblocks (KMS, VPC options)
- Agree on a mutual action plan and timeline to start the POC

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed Aug 18, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Aug 18, 10:30–11:00am
- Thu Aug 19, 2:00–2:45pm

Can you please share which of these works (or paste a couple of times that do)? Also let me know which of your execs will join — we typically have our VP Product (Vivek) and a solutions engineer (Ethan) on the call for the technical portion.

Attaching a draft mutual action plan (Acme_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) and I'll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this unblocked.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
